concept.subject: A shower of comets streaking down through the lilac sky from the upper right toward the lower left, a few large ones among many small meteors.
concept.composition: Straight, parallel streaks cross the whole picture at about 30 degrees, each with its head at its lower left end and its tail trailing up to the right. The longest comes in at the lower left corner; one has its head just left of the middle at two fifths of the height, others low on the left, at the bottom middle and low on the right, and small meteors are scattered between them. The top center is open space.
concept.layout: 62 round pegs and 82 bricks. Each comet's tail is a brick slide running up to the right, and the three largest comets' heads are brick rings open underneath, so a ball that gets inside falls out. The high comet's tail turns into a solid where it passes right of the cannon, sheltering the sparks under it. Small meteors are short brick dashes; faint meteors and sparks along the tails are pegs in pairs and short rows.

difficulty.note: Second easiest: the tails deliver balls down to the comets' heads, while the high tail's solid end shelters the sparks right of the cannon.

background.prompt: A meteor shower in a soft lilac-gray outer space: many straight, thin streaks of pale cyan-white light run parallel down to the lower left at about 30 degrees, each with a bright head at its lower left end and a soft tail trailing up to the right. The longest crosses the lower left corner; one has its head just left of the middle at about two fifths of the picture height; others have their heads low on the left at about seven tenths of the height, at the bottom middle and low on the right at about the same height; short faint meteors are scattered between them. The background is plain and calm, open at the top center.
